fields.finding: Saying uniform mismatch does not bow a member does not evaluate circumferential tube heating, asymmetric film traction or thermal imperfections.
fields.proposed_fix: Calculate thermal curvature and load eccentricity for actual tube and attachment temperatures and add the resulting imperfection to the member stability calculation.

claim: Saying uniform mismatch does not bow a member does not evaluate circumferential tube heating, asymmetric film traction or thermal imperfections.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
